title: Independent check of Sesotho direct-sowing comparative proposal
status: Meaning check only; no fluency approval or repository changes.
sourceEnglish: They do better sown straight where they’ll grow.

currentLearnerBinding.currentComposedSentence: They do better ha di jalwa ka kotloloho moo di tla hola teng.

segments.text: ha di jalwa ka kotloloho moo di tla hola teng.

proposedTarget: Di sebetsa hamolemo ha di jalwa ka kotloloho moo di tla hola teng.
backtranslation: They perform/do better when they are sown directly where they will grow.
reason: “Hamolemo” carries the comparative better, while “di sebetsa” expresses general performance rather than growth alone. “Ha di jalwa ka kotloloho moo di tla hola teng” preserves the condition and direct-sowing location. The proposal composes with the existing target prefix and leaves the crop-list suffix untouched.

composition.existingPrefixPreserved: Dijalo tse ding ha di rate hore metso ya tsona e tshwenngwe.
composition.existingConditionPreserved: ha di jalwa ka kotloloho moo di tla hola teng.

limits: This checks comparative/general-performance meaning and composition only. Sesotho idiom, spelling conventions, and learner comprehension still need fluent/local review.
Do not read this as growth-only: “di sebetsa” is work/perform, not “grow.”
